method: Static local import/export reachability, excludes test/spec files; indirect reachability is not proof of rendering. Barrel exports can over-approximate reachability. Native controls are candidates, not defects. Native template controls parsed with Vue compiler AST (comments excluded); h() native controls in .ts parsed with TypeScript AST.

backend_static_inventory.method: All Python source parsed; counts and async entrypoints inventoried. This is not a full semantic audit of every function.
